question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

The doctor said that the patient named Rumi is in the ______________(initial) stage of lung cancer.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"initial"** means occurring at the beginning; first. (प्रारंभिक)

 
 
• **Example: **In the initial stages of the project, we faced many challenges.
 
 
 
• **"Terminal" **refers to the end or extremity of something, especially a disease that is incurable and leads to death. (अंतिम)
 
 
• **Example: **The patient was in the terminal stage of cancer, where palliative care was the primary focus.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'initial' **is **'terminal'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Innermost** (अंतःस्थ): Situated farthest within.

 
 
• **Example:** She shared her innermost thoughts with her closest friend.
 
 
 
• **Early** (प्रारंभिक): Happening or done before the usual or expected time.
 
 
• **Example: **We caught an early train to avoid the rush.
 
 
 
• **Outermost** (सबसे बाहरी): Farthest from the center or on the outside.
 
 
• **Example:** The outermost layer of the Earth is called the crust.
